activity_summary: You began the fifth act at the oath: no woman within a mile, three years, four hands set to it. Under that you wrote that the four are sworn and the park is still empty. You did not take the sheet any further this sitting.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Wrote the oath and did not fill the space under it.

entities.name: Love's Labour's Lost
entities.context: Mentioned in Four hands to an oath

facets.activity: Set down the oath and stopped
